column7: DeleteProjectIfEmpty counted secrets without locking the project row, so a concurrent CreateSecret defeated the refuse-if-not-empty rule and was swept. It now takes the project row lock first, then counts (internal/storage/store/local_secrets.go). Same fix and test as delete-project-if-empty-lock-order-001 (tracked there under #2887); this row records that #2796 itself is closed. Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
